notes.title: Chapter 28/Epilogue 3 + Game 2 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Happy May everyone! It's high time for another development update. I'll start with PoP stuff, then get into Game 2.

PoP: Thanks to everyone who's played Epilogue 2! Epilogue 3 is underway already and will focus much more on changes between relationships as the ladies progress through their pregnancy. I won't give too much away, but the title will be "Late Night Snacks", so you can expect Michael to go on a very fun miniquest. :)

Game 2: The next game will be a combination of a reverse trainer game and mini "city" management game. You'll be working with one of the two main LIs (a fiery redhead tsundere) to help uncorrupt our other main LI, who's been possessed by a succubus. You'll be balancing this reverse training with managing food, water, and other resources in the rather bleak and desolate magical hellscape you find yourselves trapped in.

That's right - there'll be actual gameplay to go with your wholesome story and handholding! It'll be a far more difficult game to create than a simple VN on the technical end of things, but my hope is that the limited number of environments will allow me to create even more cool and detailed custom environments in Blender. :) I'm sure my Blender skills will progress over time as I create more and more art in the system, but my dream goal is to have animated sprites over animated environments, all with physically realistic effects (ie. clothes draping nicely, water flowing, beds deforming when you sit on them, etc.). There'll still be regular CGs (full renders) for important scenes, but sprites for your more "basic" interactions.

As much as I'm looking forward to the fun of creating all this cool art and designing gameplay systems, the primary focus of the game will always be the plot and characters. By focusing on just three characters and putting them in an environment where they'll be constantly interacting and reacting to one another, my goal is to make each of them feel complex, interesting, and real. I think I achieved that to some extent with PoP, but the best way to develop character is to show it in the way they interact with one another and the world. That's hard to do in a fairly linear VN format, but when you can perform in-game actions and see how characters react to them and see how those reactions change over time... That's when you really feel the character development. That's really the fundamental purpose of the gameplay and art for me; they exist to bring the story and characters to life.

I won't go on for any longer, but hopefully that's a good insight into the near-term plans for the PoP and the longer-term plans for Game 2. :)

notes.title: Price of Power Release!

Happy Valentine's Day everyone! Price of Power has been a labor of love for over four years, and I'm very happy and proud to say that the game is finally ready for a full release! The main plot is complete, I've done some cleanup work on earlier renders, fixed up some bugs and typos, and added in requested features like a scene gallery and an SFW mode. With all this work finally done, the game is now leaving Early Access! The current price will only last for a couple weeks, at which point it'll be increasing to $19.99 USD as 
I said earlier. Grab it now while you can!

Also as promised earlier, this isn't the end of Price of Power - there's still more to come. I'll be working on the five epilogue chapters now to keep expanding the story, and they'll all be available for free as part of the game. You can see my earlier development updates for details on what I've been planning, as well as leave me ideas for things you might want to see!

Thank you all for your support over the last few years; I couldn't have done this without you. I hope you've enjoyed the game and will enjoy the epilogues coming up in the next few months. :)

The most important thing: Chapter 25, which will be the end of the main plot, will be out before Thanksgiving. I'm aiming for the weekend of November 23rd, but as we get closer, I'll update everyone as usual. :) What happens after that? Great question!

Once Chapter 25 is done, I'll be working on reviewing the entire game and polishing anything that needs polishing (renders, writing, animations - whatever needs to be fixed). After that, I'll begin working on the five epilogue chapters. To that end, I'll be posting polls and requesting ideas for scenes/scenarios that would be fun for the characters. I have a general idea of what I want the epilogue to be, but I definitely want to include some supporter requests and do a bit of fan service. If you already have ideas, feel free to post them as comments below! No guarantees on every suggestion making it in, but if it's a particularly good idea that works with the overall vision, then I'll happily include it.

Concurrently to the epilogue chapters being created, I'll begin learning Blender and starting to design the next game. Don't expect to hear many solid details on that for a while, though, since I still have a fair bit of PoP to get through first. :)

Lastly - GO DODGERS!

notes.title: Chapter 23 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Happy Saturday everyone! Hope you all are doing well. :) This will be a longer dev update than usual, so you are warned in advance!

I'll start with the most important thing: Chapter 23 is on track for release on July 31st. I'm just past halfway done with rendering scene 5 of 6, so everything is going as expected. :) I've been having more problems with Daz than usual, which have eaten up lots of time (like having to fully uninstall/reinstall, or having to run 60 renders one at a time by hand), but I've managed to get through it all relatively unscathed. If you're ever wondering whether or not you should use Daz for a long-term video game project, the answer is almost assuredly [b]no[/b].

On a personal/professional note - I'm leaving my IRL job at the end of this upcoming week. Since I started work on Price of Power, I've been working a full-time job + game dev on nights and weekends. It's been quite exhausting, especially at the position I've been at for the last ~two years. Two hours of commuting per day, eight hours of work, then squeezing in game development work once home has not been the easiest. 60-70 hour weeks have been the norm for the last three years, and burnout has definitely started to set in over the last few months. So, to fix that, I'm leaving that IRL job...

To do game development full-time! Thanks to your support, I've been able to save up a decent bit of money - enough to let me take a stab at being a full-time game developer (for the near/medium-term). I've got about 24 months to make this all work, so I'm hopeful that you'll all be able and willing to keep supporting me as I try to make this into my one and only job! I know I regularly thank you all for your support already, but I really do appreciate it; without everyone who supports this game, I couldn't even take this chance. So, thank you for enabling this, and I promise to do my best with this opportunity. :)

Once I've taken some time to recover from constant 60-70 hour weeks and waking up at 5 in the damn morning, I'll be working on PoP full-time until I've gotten all 30 chapters done. :) The current development roadmap is still what I'm working towards, but as I get into the groove of working on PoP when I'm not exhausted/sleep-deprived, I may tweak and accelerate it. At the current pace/plan, Chapter 30 should be done in around a year, hopefully less once I get into the hang of things. I don't want to go too aggressive on timelines right now and end up putting out a rushed finale right after I say that I'm focusing on game development. So, no changes to the dev roadmap until I can properly recover, reassess everything, and finish this game off in the way it deserves. :) 

I'm sure some of you are wondering what happens after PoP, if I'm doing this full time and only have a year or so left. I don't want to give too much away, but I can confidently say that I've got a game 2 in mind that I'm already deep in the ideation stage of creating. It'll still be 10-12 months until PoP is finished and I can focus on game 2, but I've already got a pretty clear vision of what that'll look like. Let's just say that if you like wholesome fantasy romances (and if you're here, I assume you do), you'll probably like this game. :) I won't be straying from my roots, but I want to do everything I did in PoP better. More player agency, more gameplay mechanics, better renders (hopefully using a better tool than Daz), etc. - it's all on the table and I'll be working towards that as I close PoP out and prepare for the future.

Thanks for reading, and thank you again for making this all possible!

notes.title: Chapter 18 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Figured it's well past time I give an update regarding PoP development. :) Well, I do those frequently on the Discord (join!), but not as often on Patreon or Steam, since I figured the people who want lots of progress updates would join the Discord and get pretty much daily updates. Should I do more frequent formal dev updates, though? Let me know in the comments!

Anyways, game progress is going exactly as expected. I'm still working through scene 3, but scenes 3 and 4 are the biggest chunks of content in the update, so that's expected. As you can probably tell from the title of the chapter (Maid of Honor), there's a lot of romance plot content and progression. I've already completed the lewd scene and animations that both paths will get (moved from the prior chapter), and I'm pretty happy with how my animation skills have been improving over time. I'm not a master yet, but I definitely think I'm getting better. However, pure romance content is my favorite content to write, since Maria, Emilia, and the MC all play off another really nicely in that regard. When Lune and Zaya come into the mix (depending on your path, obviously), they'll provide another really fun and interesting dynamic. This update is really focused on those three, though Lune and Zaya will take an increasingly large role in the following chapters.

If you're on the throuple path, this chapter is where the romance path will really kick off. The romance situation is a major focal point (if not the main focus point) of this chapter, so you can expect a ton of content regarding how that's coming about. There will also be a throuple path lewd scene that is unavailable for solo path; people who want harem path eventually are on the throuple path for now. It's not going to be a full-on threesome - that would be too fast for a slow-burn game - but it will definitely not be a two-player game, if you know what I mean.

If you're on the Maria-only path, this chapter deals more with everyone's places in the group, dealing with lingering tension between Maria and Emilia (since Emilia is not a "threat" in the solo path), and that sort of thing. This chapter will have slightly less content if you're on the Maria-only path, just because there's obviously a lot of narrative/romance work that has to go into setting up the other path. There is a Maria-only path lewd scene that throuple path players will not get, so that's something, but you can expect something like 80-90% of the content that throuple path players will get in this chapter. Other chapters will make up the difference in content so that, by the end, all the routes have pretty equal time compared to one another. :) I just want to make sure that everyone's clear from the outset that all paths get their time in the sun by the end of the game, but this chapter is definitely heavier on the throuple path than the solo route.

This has turned into a much, much longer dev update than I expected, so I'll just close with the expected release timeline. In short, August 25th is my goal, but it could slide to August 27th. My birthday is right before the release date as is a big and important work project deadline, so while I'm aiming to get everything out by August 25th, the final polishes could take until the 26th or 27th. As usual, once we get closer to the release date, I'll be able to finalize it. :)

TLDR: Throuple path has a bit more content than Maria path in this chapter. Each path has a unique lewd scene, plus a lewd scene that everyone gets. Aiming for August 25th-27th release window.
